# Parced

Parced is a real-estate closing platform: one file per property, from
accepted offer to recorded deed. A Dart backend and a Flutter client
share one domain model — escrow timelines, contingencies and title are
the interesting part; everything else is listings and paperwork around
it.

## Layout
- `lib/escrow/` — timelines and contingency deadlines (start here)
- `lib/title/`  — exceptions and county records
- `lib/offers/` — offers and counter-offers
